entries.reason: iOS 6 has a CIColor but not this: the release's CoreImage has no way to name the colour space a colour was measured in, so an application that names one of these does not find it
entries.effect: the colour of those components as the named space sees it, made by matching it into the space the renderer works in
entries.source: the header of the iOS 16.4 SDK for the contract; the host's own CoreImage over the same calls, by tests/backports/host/ciimage/pixel, which asks each colour twice and prints the numbers the colour holds and the bytes an image of it renders to; the 6.1.3 armv7 dyld cache for what the release does not export
